Submitting opens WhatsApp with your details filled in and sends them to the showroom you picked. Nothing is stored on this website. See our privacy policy.

What the lender will ask for

  • Identity and address

    Aadhaar and PAN, plus a current address proof.

  • Income proof

    Three to six months of bank statements, or recent salary slips if you are salaried.

  • A photograph

    Passport size, or we can take one at the showroom.

  • Down payment

    Zero down payment schemes exist, but a larger down payment cuts the interest you pay overall.

Pillai Auto is not a lender and does not provide financial advice. Loan approval and terms rest entirely with the financing partner.
